messages.text: bro did you actually write out the van vs keep-the-truck math yet or are you still pretending you'll decide by vibes 😂
Two pages already. Left side is payment/insurance, right side is lost weekends and whether the Acadia can keep limping.
bring the blue wirebound thing when i come up friday. i'll add the stuff i wish somebody told me before buying the trailer
It's in the truck bag. Same section as the business-launch numbers.
bro did you see the cap hit thing today
I saw. If 17 is gone I am not reading comments until June.
same misery different sport 😂
At least the blue hoodie still works for both rooms.
I have the museum lobby table held for March 21 after my reference shift. Same loose format: bring two prints, no speeches.
Good. I can bring the Acadia fog frame and the old quarry shot if you think those fit.
Bring the quarry one. The sky has that Adams restraint you pretend not to care about.
Fine, but only if you save five minutes for the print by the west stairs again.
I will ring you after the 7 o'clock dishes are put away.  Nothing urgent.
That works. I just got in from the run, so five minutes is about right.
Good. I marked the envelope from the doctor's office in my old billing folder so I do not lose it.
I'll look at it Sunday when I'm down there.
still coming over tomorrow or did work eat you alive
I'm in. I'll bring the Martin and the capo this time.
good because your g run on paradise needs help lol
Only if we follow it with Orphan Girl so you suffer a little too.
lot at 5:55? loop is mostly dry but the last climb is chewed up.
Yeah. I am doing the 10-minute floor stuff before I leave. Left side still complains on steep downhills.
Do the band walk too. Same one I gave you after the Sewards mess.
Already packed the band. Also throwing tissues in the vest because that yellow dust is starting early.
bro that miter saw listing is tempting but dont blow up march already 😂
I have the house numbers open. Normal line is 3,200, saw would push it close to 4,000.
then put it on the end-of-month plastic and let the miles do something for once
bro if youre making your little december envelope already add like 40 bucks for tolls this year 😂
Maybe. Same account already has heat, groceries, Mom's CVS run, and the truck fill-ups landing this week.
I had $400 penciled in for the usual gifts and the ride down to your place. Do not make it worse.
i opened a wall on Union St today and found knob tube from the stone age so yes everything is worse
That rowhouse is going to start charging you rent.
Do you still have the Jay Street frame from June 2020? The one where the City Hall steps are half in shadow.
I have one Schenectady roll from that day. Mostly backs of heads and a crooked sign, but the steps one is usable.
The frame with the paw on the windowsill is stronger than you think. The scratch marks in the sill read almost like a timestamp.
Did you see the county line changes for the June sheet? I am updating my little research folder before I forget.
Those were from the first winter after Hannah's Glens Falls stuff was out. Solder kept watching the driveway from that window.
I saw the postcard. Need to check it against the address list before I mark the calendar. I hate walking in cold.
Send that one when you can. Also, the two links I sent are both taking March gifts through Friday.
I set one for $20 tonight and left the $25 one for payday. Keeping the photo off family Facebook, though.
That explains the quiet in it. Keep the caption factual, maybe just the month and the room.
Same. I still compare every local name separately. The top row is usually quicker for me; town seats take actual reading.
I'll mark it spare room, Nov 2023. No need to make it bigger than that.
Yeah. Since 16, 20, and 24 the top line has not been much of a debate for me. The smaller offices are where I slow down.
I found a loose envelope in the secretary drawer with P. Petrarca written on it. Do you still need this address?
Yes, keep that one. I use it every December.
I put it with your extra stamps and the red cards from last year. Love, Mom
you still making it over at 7 or did the appliance gods win
7 works. Got held up after the west bench crowd because Devon wanted me to check his notes and Marisol had questions on the tag photos.
classic you eating a cold sandwich while grading homework lol
Pretty much. I still have the March packet in my bag, so if I start talking about ladder stickers during Prine just throw a pick at me.
After run Saturday, Dan's place is doing flights and a patio fire. You in?
Run and one beer, yeah. If the patio turns into Ray's porch situation I'll be inside with fries.
Fair. I'll grab the corner table by the windows.
Did you get back from Schenectady before the rain started?
Just made it. Diane ran a few minutes over, but I still beat the worst of it.
I am glad you still keep those Thursdays.  You waited so long for that first opening years ago.
Yeah, I remember calling in May and not sitting in that chair until September.
Rain holding. Same 6 at the lot.
Good. I'll come straight from the last service call.
Dave said stay off the lower muddy stretch.
Fine by me. Ankles vote yes.
Allen + Cliff still on the July board?
Yeah. I started the notes folder again. Same ritual: maps, weather bookmarks, dumb amount of sock math.
You doing the top-out pause thing or are we moving like normal people
Ten minutes. Coffee, no phone, look around before we drop. You can survive.
you alive bro or did the friday board bury you
Just parked. Five stops plus a compressor quote that should have been simple.
five on a friday is rude 😂
It was the 5:45 coffee doing all the heavy lifting by stop three.
where did the cushion land after those state fed deposits bro
A little over $18,000 now. I moved the $1,800 and then shut the spreadsheet before I overthought it.
march still light or you forcing it
Light. Leaving the usual sweep off and letting paycheck cover the shop runs.
CVS on Market Street says my new United card does not match what they have.  I still have the red, white, and blue card in my purse.
Keep both out. I'll stop after work and have them run the red-white-blue one first, then the UHC Plan G card.
Thank you. Also, did you finish your work forms? You said the eye card and retirement percentage were due Friday.
Almost. Blue Cross HMO stayed the same, eye plan uploaded, and I bumped the 401k line to the full 4.
Did Market Street CVS text you yet?  I can pick up my card there after church if you need me to get yours too.
Mine says ready after 10:30. Just the little 50 mg one Dr. Patel keeps renewing, so I'll swing by myself.
Good.  Please do not stretch that bottle again like you did a few years ago before you called Saint Mary's.
I won't. That 2022 experiment bought me enough trouble for one lifetime.
If your Gary sends you toward Utica on Monday, could you stop here on your way back? The top rack is cloudy again.
Likely Schenectady early, Utica late. I'll know after the Amsterdam board gets posted.
That is a lot of driving for one day.  Please eat something real, not just coffee.
Gary usually lets me stack the calls so I'm not bouncing twice. I'll text you once the last ticket closes.
river side clear this morning?
looked fine from the bridge. grabbing a lid at Russo's and then cutting past the water.
good. send pace after, ankle notes too.
will do. stairs were icy at the upper door but sidewalk's clean once I'm off Market.
If we do Stacks before the meetup, I can be there at 9:10. I remember you said the second cup after noon makes the rest of the day weird.
9:10 works. I'll bring my own pour-over from home and just get food there.
Good. Also, if you are still seeing Mei on Central, book before the spring rush. The shoulder-jaw thing shows up in your photos before you notice it.
I have her at 4:30 Thursday. Fish oil and D3 are back in the glove box too, so March Rickey is officially boring.
NYT ran a useful piece on the spring guidance. Less breathless than the headline suggests.
Send it over? I want to see if it matches what Dr. Patel said after she looked at my CVS printout.
Link attached. Katelyn's Friday note is clearer on timing, as usual.
Perfect. My record shows the fall one plus the last HPV page, so mostly checking dates.
you alive after the fancy saratoga stove thing lol
Barely. First pass was three hours and change. That 1962 GE has more personality than the owner.
did the little internet thermostat box behave or did it try to burn the place down
Bench test behaved. Going back Tuesday to tuck the sensor and clean up the control cavity before I bill it.
saratoga after the guitar shop or are you racing back
I can do one stop. Druthers if we're eating there, then I'm calling it.
lol you and your two and done rule
That rule has earned its keep. Plus I still have Out of Bounds in the fridge for tomorrow.
that sub thread you sent me about the ice maker had me dying lol dude kept blaming the outlet
I answered him after lunch. Told him to check voltage at the valve before buying the whole module.
you and your meter leads save another stranger thirty bucks
Maybe. I was typing it in the van while the OEM app was crawling through a fridge board test.
bro you still doing those little auto moves on the 1st or did the truck eat that plan 😂
Still doing them. Tires got their $38, and I left the random-house-stuff account alone after that National Grid $280 in January.
smart. my feb gas bill punched me in the mouth too
May should be closer to $90, so March is just me filling the gaps before the next cold stretch.
Did you ever make the spreadsheet version I suggested, or are you still doing envelope math on a legal pad?
Spreadsheet finally. Two fixed drafts are boxed in red so I stop pretending they are optional: 185 and 389.
Good. Red boxes are not elegant, but they are honest.
March looks workable if I leave the camera repair until April and keep fuel boring.
Did you ever get to the farm essays I left on the hold shelf, or did the paperback about the barber win?
barber book is winning. i made it through another chapter after dishes instead of opening the usual little doom-machine.
That is probably the least cursed substitution available to a person with a couch and a lamp.
the phone lives by the coffee maker after 9 now. makes me annoyed for ten minutes, then i actually read.
I am making roast beef today.  Please bring milk if you stop at Hannaford. Love, Mom
I can. Also I printed the riverfront parking sketch you asked about. We can look at that before the game.
Good. I would rather talk about that than whatever they are shouting about on Channel 10 this morning.
Same plan as usual: milk, dishwasher check, parking sketch, roast beef.
Please take a piece of pot roast home if you want it. I know you have your containers to fill tonight.
Thanks Mom. I already have rice going when I get back, but I won't say no to one slice.
Do not forget the papers you printed for tomorrow. They are still on the table by your jacket. Love, Mom
Saw your tire post. All set for Tuesday run or is the car still at the shop?
All set. It was 402 and change, put it on the card so I could get out of there.
Good. Annoying hit, not catastrophic.
Yeah. Goldman transfer is queued for tomorrow morning, then I will zero the card line back out.
did you rerun your monthly sheet with the new shop rate or still using last fall numbers bro
Updated it yesterday. Main checks are penciling out around 4,200 for the month after taxes and the payroll deduction.
and the side calls?
Last month cleared 850 after parts. I am still keeping the yearly Vanguard bucket on schedule before I pad the business fund.
The third frame from this morning has the cleanest rhythm. The rail shadow almost does too much, but the mill stack in the back saves it.
That was the one from the middle of the span, facing west. I was there before the first dog walker got across.
Use that one, then. And please do not caption it like you accidentally found it in your coat pocket.
Fine. I'll put it in the @barham.silvergelatin drafts and try not to apologize for it.
For the April contact sheets, pack fewer rolls than your spreadsheet says. Fog will make you linger.
I trimmed it to 8 rolls and two cards. Friday drive, Monday back, no museum stops unless the weather turns ugly.
Good. Also, the Reykjanes geothermal book is on hold for you. Leave the Tokyo photobook for later; it is gorgeous but not the same problem.
That is the order in my head too. Steam and black rock before neon and trains.
you still coming wed or buried in that appliance homework lol
Still coming. I need one more laundry module and the USA invoice printed for the tax folder.
homework and invoices rock n roll lifestyle lmao
If I pass the core section before April, I get the discount on the next two tests.
How did the new basement setup feel before work?
Awkward but okay. Still figuring out the safeties. Legs are not fresh enough for the community center run tonight.
Then keep your minutes short. No hero stuff on that floor.
Yeah, I'll mostly pass and get out. Friday morning I'll adjust the J-hooks one notch lower.
ray forwarded another wall of caps this morning bro. bev says do not answer it at lunch
Not touching it. Last November I mentioned the Jay St march for about ten seconds and the whole table froze.
lol i remember him stabbing the potatoes like they owed him money
I would rather put $25 toward the Hamilton Hill page Joelle sent and keep dinner quiet.
Mrs. Kowalski called me by mistake again. She said the little spinning circle is back on her tablet.
I'll go over after work tomorrow. Same thing happened at the table Saturday when half the room was on that old router.
She told me to remind you she saved you two pierogi.  You are spoiled.
That's payment enough. I'll bring the big-font notes I used last weekend.
you still bringing that contact sheet tomorrow or did the mountain stare you down again lol
Bringing it. Crane roll is weirdly quiet. One summit frame, one boot shot, mostly trees.
quiet is fine man. same way that garage pic with your old man and the green machine works
That one still has the corner bent from when we taped it over the bench all summer.
found the fmcc motor controls notebook in a box and your handwriting was somehow worse in 2013 lmao
That notebook passed us both, show some respect.
also sending you that gillian break i messed with for tomorrow
Send it. I'll try to keep up after work and not butcher the second verse.
still good for 7 or are you folded up inside another rich guy fridge lol
7 works. Spent two hours half inside a wall oven so I need the roller first.
bring the small guitar then dont make me watch you stand up like an old table
Small guitar and the soft case. Also grabbing the clear-eyed stuff before I head over, the shop bay is all dust today.
I marked the Salgado pages you mentioned. Also: did the two-column list help before bed this week?
A little. Diane keeps pushing me to write the looping stuff down instead of checking the work calendar five times.
That sounds like a very Diane assignment. Bring it on the 19th?
Yep. Same Schenectady run, just moved to 2:30 because of a morning install.
The juried show deadline is April 15. Have you chosen the three frames, or are they still being tried in court?
Court is in recess. I have Bass Harbor, the bridge sunrise, and the fogged-over carriage road on one side. The other side is mostly entry fee, printing cost, and the part where strangers see it.
That is very you. Send me the page totals after you stop pretending this is a strictly financial exercise.
When you get a chance, could you look at the photo I sent of my dishwasher panel? The top rack is cloudy again. Love, Mom
I saw it. I'm between stops and already have the tablet open, so I'll pull the code sheet before noon.
Do not order anything expensive for it unless you are sure.
I won't. I'll check the board values first and only price the little harness if the numbers point there.
saturday still good for the range after breakfast
Yeah. I want to check the 30-06 before I put it back in the cabinet for the season.
cool bring that town map too my uncle is yelling about the new line behind his lot lol
I'll bring the zoning printout. It looked like a setback change, not a taking.
6 tonight still?
Maybe 6:20. Gary let me swap the Utica fridge call for two Schenectady stops but I'm still leaving Amsterdam with a full truck.
Works. Lot by the bridge.
If the twelve-man board explodes again I'll message before you drive over.
lot at 5:55 or are you doing couch scout night
lot at 5:55 or are you still doing Saint Mary's first?
Run first. I can be useless in front of the Combine replays after.
Saint Mary's ran late. Patel wanted one more month logged before changing the refill length.
6 p.m. still good? Easy loop, no hero hills.
blue-red hat counts as reflective gear?
Running late. Had to scan Mom's two cards for CVS again, then HR pinged me about the cert fee form.
skip the first mile then. no need to sprint from a waiting room.
Only if nobody says wide right before mile two.
Lot at 6:10 then. Also did you move that crown appointment or just the estimate?
Fair. Also he said keep the morning 50 exactly as-is, so no weird timing around runs.
Moved the chair time. Estimate can sit until I see what comes out of the next check.
coffee after or straight home?
Straight home. Linda usually catches me around 7 on Thursdays and I need a shower first.
thumbs up. Warm-up looked better tonight.
Thanks. I also need to ask her whether the Division Street bulletin has the Easter week times yet.
bro i can leave the little tin in the truck this time 😂
Appreciated. My house, my boring rules.
still thinking about burlington huh
Hard to forget 2 a.m. math about whether my heart was doing normal heart things.
The repair invoice page you sent has your card number masked correctly, but the bank line is visible at the bottom.
Good catch. Cropped it. That little Goldman bucket was at 11,086 before the tire mess, so nothing dramatic.
Much cleaner. Also, I appreciate that your financial paperwork has better composition than some gallery submissions.
Only because I paid the card first and photographed the boring version after.
I found another box from the basement marked Wayne - 2018.  I will leave it by the stairs.
Thanks. I'll go through it Sunday after dinner. I have Diane at 4:30 Monday if it kicks anything loose.
Good.  Please do not bring anything extra from Saratoga this weekend. One of those Common Roots cans with pot roast is plenty.
Deal. I'll bring milk and keep the fridge as-is.
The CVS receipt is on the kitchen table.  It was $18.47 after the new card finally worked.
Thanks. I put it with this week's pile so I can add it Sunday night.
You do keep such careful lists. Please do not forget the milk for Sunday. Love, Mom
Milk, dishwasher tabs, and the receipt are all in the same note. I'll run it through the card with the rest.
did the marketplace special collapse yet lol
Still standing. Tightened the left upright before I left for work.
good because i am not rewiring your basement twice lmao
Fair. Also my shoes are still in the truck from the center last night, so at least one bag is packed.
found the old motor controls binder in my basement lol petrarca wrote like a judge
Keep that. His notes in the margins were better than half the handouts.
you ever hear back after that breakfast place thing
Yeah, he sent a short note after. Same neat handwriting.
Lot at 7:55 tomorrow?
Yep. Might keep the first mile easy. Left arm is cranky from the CVS stop.
Which one did they give you?
Tdap. Patel's office said my old date was close enough to update before I forget again. CDC table said same window.
I found the receipt from your tires in the glove box when I borrowed the folder. It says November 18, 2024.
Good, I was missing that date. That came from the winter car line, same place this year's tire money is going.
Also, my National Grid paper says $276.91 for January. Yours was about the same, correct?
Mine rounded to $280. I marked May at $90 so I don't treat March like a normal month.
you still coming over wed or did the bank app ruin your mood lol
Still coming. I looked because I hate myself apparently. The little one is just over 9 now and the big one is still a hair under 14.1.
thats not nothing but its moving
Yeah. The 185 barely moves the needle, the 389 actually makes a dent.
lot at 7:55?
lot at 7:55?
Yeah. I gave myself the softer Saturday start and still have time for oatmeal.
yep. i stayed out of the rectangle trap last night and got to bed decent for once.
good. hills will notice.
rain holding, going.
Good. No service board today unless the green pager ruins it.
also hit the part with nathan coulter and the creek. slower than a feed reel, better for sleep.
You running Saturday 4/18 or is that the coast weekend?
Coast. Hiking shoes and tripod instead of the group run. I put Schoodic before sunrise if my ankle behaves.
Do the warmup anyway. Those boardwalks and wet rock count.
I will. Need the legs decent for someday lava-field walking too, though the Kyoto plan can wait.
I found your old little stickers in the desk drawer from the firehouse years.  Do you want them or may I toss them?
Toss them. I kept the 2024 one on the truck visor for a while because I squeezed it in between the Fort Johnson fridge call and Mrs. Kowalski's washer.
That sounds like you.  Please make sure you still read the judges and county names. Those matter too. Love, Mom
I do. The big box takes me about ten seconds; the county stuff is where I ask around first.
you still got the glens falls crate in your basement or did hannah finally take that thing lol
Gone. I kept the smaller carrier because Solder actually fits in it.
good because that crate ate half your laundry room
Laundry room is just tools, detergent, and her food bin now. Cleaner than it was.
you alive or buried in appliance hieroglyphics lol
Half buried. Bosch sheet is printed, Whirlpool list is next. Also waiting on the salmon glaze to tack up.
miso again?
Yeah. Faster than dealing with chicken and it fits the little glass rectangles better.
Crane lot was iced over when I drove by. Still wild you went up solo in November.
Needed the quiet that day. Sat up top longer than planned.
Makes sense. Same week you skipped the group run and helped Linda sort Wayne's old boxes, right?
Yeah. Found the little parts list from the Maytag and a coffee can full of cotter pins.
saw your post before the run. those beams looked cold.
They were. Fingers went numb winding the roll back by the river.
worth it. 799 now?
800 if the new one sticks. I should have waited for October light, but March fog did enough.
The frame you sent from last year's ridge line has the same patience as the Acadia dawn set. Less dramatic, better.
That one was after everybody stopped talking for a bit. Light finally came through and I just waited it out.
Keep that restraint in the edit. Also: label the place more specifically than 'up north,' please.
Fine. I'll use the actual peak name when I sequence it.
When you get a chance, can you look at the printer? It keeps saying tray empty when it is not.
I can stop after work. I need to print the proctor form and that USA card anyway.
I will have paper here. Also, I saved the pot roast for you.
Perfect. The form has to match my driver license before they unlock the cooking section.
Bev says Ray found another old High Peaks photo album and wants you to see it before it gets put in the closet again.
Tell him to leave the 46er lecture notes in pencil so I can correct his mileage guesses.
I will not be telling Raymond that. Also, Erica mailed the pecans from North Carolina early this year.
Good. Put mine away before Brian turns it into pie filling in December.
you still doing the glens falls thing at 6 or can i borrow the torque wrench
Still going. Pete's picking the route and Dave has my spare lamp.
lol those two have you on a leash
Swing by after 7:30 and grab it from the bench.
bro can i crash sat the 21st or is that your little phone clinic thing
Clinic thing was the 7th this month. You're fine. Mrs. K may still hijack me for the thermostat screen after dinner though.
that lady pays better than my clients if she feeds you again 😂
She sent home soup last time and made me retape the password card to the remote.
The Schenectady frame works better small. It reads like you were standing just outside the crowd, which is actually the interesting part.
The county broadband map is finally readable. The western hamlets still look stranded.
The Saratoga sequence works better if the closed-panel shot comes before the glowing readout. It feels less like a gadget ad that way.
That is about right. I was near the curb most of the afternoon and left before the second loop.
That makes sense. I need one page that says old appliances can stay useful without looking hacked together.
I saw that. I bookmarked the public comment form and sent Mom the two-page version, minus the Albany circus.
Understood. Also, the workplace-match form closes Monday if you want that $20 to count twice.
Wise edit. The map is the useful part anyway.
Done. And please do not tag me. Ray can turn a holiday plate into talk radio without help.
Use the Stratoliner as the proof, then. Also, the Mohawk Valley Sustainable Appliance name is stronger when you let the images carry most of the claim.
Exactly. She'll read street names and pole counts. Anything past that becomes Sunday table static.
I'm making a folder for that. Saratoga, the two March invoices, and maybe the kit sketch if it stops looking like a napkin crime.
If you go by Russo's today, would you please ask whether they still sell the small almond biscotti?  Aunt Bev liked them.
Already here. I'll check before I head back toward Market.
Thank you. Also, did the upstairs bedroom radiator stop clanking after you bled it?
Mostly. other bedroom is still a little noisy when the heat kicks on.
you bringing the little kettle tonight or am i making gas station mud lol
Kettle's in the truck. One small one before we start and I'm done.
wild remembering you used to murder four or five of those black deli cups on service days
Last March taught me. Also remind me to grab the D3 bottle off your amp before I leave.
6 still good?
Yeah. Ate at the west bench and got out before the service board blew up.
ankle warm-up before you drive over.
I will. Devon and Marisol both cornered me over lunch, so I need ten quiet minutes anyway.
Did the new number at work actually change your fall submission math, or are you still pretending juried-show fees are irresponsible?
It helped some. Two regular deposits are landing about 4,200 total now, and the side jobs covered 850 last month.
That sounds like a frame budget, not an excuse.
Maybe after the automatic 6 percent at work and the $7,000 yearly bucket stay untouched.
Good morning. The maple tree is covering the porch again. I left a box of soft tissues by the door for you, just in case. Love, Mom
Thanks. I will swing by after the Elm Street dishwasher. I have to do my 10 minutes tonight before I look at yours.
Please do not crawl under mine until you have stretched out properly. I remember how you came home after that October hike.
I will be careful. If it needs more than a filter clean I am saving it for Sunday.
I washed your blue sweatshirt from Sunday. The one with the red letters. I will leave it folded on the chair. Love, Mom
Thanks. That is the lucky one, so no dryer sheet next time if you can help it.
I did not use one. I remember. Are you coming before the 7 o'clock game or after?
Before. I will fix the top rack and be back home by puck drop.
Saratoga fee hit yet?
Yeah, from paycheck. I zeroed the March sweep instead of cracking the emergency one.
Good. Legs and accounts both get a deload week.
Still keeping the $35,000 line taped above the desk though.
bro is sunny side up still cash only or am i making that up 😂
They took my card in October when I met P. there. Coffee and toast came to like six bucks.
six bucks in 2025 is basically theft in your favor
bro the schenectady place finally got out of bounds again. grabbing a 4?
Yeah, a 4 is fine. Not a case. I still have Saturday and Sunday covered.
look at mr spreadsheet fridge 😂
Spreadsheet fridge kept 2019 from repeating, so it stays.
The reception is at the same warehouse as last year. They usually pass around those tiny wrapped squares near the loading dock, so I saved us seats away from that corner.
Thank you. My lifetime sample size is staying at four.
Understood. I will protect your sparkling-water-and-early-exit agenda.
Still deciding Saratoga 25K?
Yeah. I put race fee, ankle, and Saturday with Mom on one page last night. Opposite page is basically "need a hard thing on the calendar."
Send me a picture of the ankle line, not the whole courtroom.
After coffee. There are arrows everywhere and it looks worse than it is.
uncle ray sent another novel about the county clerk race bro 😂
I saw it. Weirdly I liked that clerk when he helped with the permit mess, so I am not throwing the whole note out.
you always do that split the sheet thing and then make fun of everybody else for being predictable
Top office has been predictable for me lately, sure. Local names earn it or they don't.
Can you still make the May print walk? The cheap room I found wants a card hold today.
I can, but I need it on the March tab before I say yes. Acadia already taught me what one weekend does to the total.
Fair. Send me your ceiling and I will stop pretending I am good at travel math.
If March stays under 3,200 after utilities post, I'll hold it. If it drifts toward 4,000, I wait until April's cycle.
I put the roast in early.  No need to hurry before church lets out.
Perfect. I let the house stay quiet until 7:30 for once.
You needed that after the pager week. Bring two quarts of milk, please. Love, Mom
Will do. I should be there around noon, unless the phone drags me out first.
When you come for dinner, could you take the small manila envelope from the hutch? It has your father's warranty card notes and that $10 tag from the sale. Love, Mom
Yes. I want to put those with the garage photo and the Crane negatives.
I remember him laughing because you two thought the rollers would never line up. He would like that you kept the picture.
I'll bring the binder Sunday and you can pick which scan looks right.
I found the little ceramic dish Hannah gave me from the clinic in Glens Falls. Would Solder use it, or should I put it in the church sale box?
Solder already ignores three dishes, so church sale is fine.
All right. I will save the pot roast for you, and send the leftover carrots home for the cat if she will not turn up her nose. Love, Mom
She'll turn up her nose, but I'll take them anyway.
so did the albany art thing survive your 2 hr drive lol
Barely. Joelle had us compare five prints and I got pinned on the quarry sky for ten minutes.
that the one that looks like a mountain record cover
Basically. Also got pulled back to that Salgado wall print like last time.
bro send me that parts pic again when you get a sec, my phone ate it 😂
After first call. I've got the folder in the truck with the belt numbers and the fridge diagram.
also your truck smells like that fish sauce stuff from yesterday or is that the customer
That one's on me. Miso lid wasn't seated on lunch number two.
ray emailed me a scan of that summit pic again lol same one he shows every time we eat in gloversville
The one where I look twelve and overdressed for a fire tower?
